title: Resources with no declared GVK must stay on the codec path
answers: Can I set StorageOptions.GVK on iam/app-SDK resources?
Why do some resources not declare a GVK in apistore.StorageOptions?
Persisted object has no apiVersion for an app-SDK generated kind
When does apistore use the legacy versioning codec instead of direct JSON encode?
body:
Invariant: resources whose generated constructors leave TypeMeta empty (app-SDK kinds like NewPlaylist(), iam's five resources, enterprise's apistore.StorageOptions callers) must not be given a non-empty StorageOptions.GVK unless they also move to GVR-keyed options registration.
Mechanism: apistore.Storage.encode (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go) branches purely on StorageOptions.GVK.Empty(): empty routes to encodeViaCodec (the k8s versioning codec resolves the storage version itself); non-empty writes the object's own GVK directly via checkGVK. Setting a GVK on a registration that's shared across multiple GVRs would collapse them onto one kind/version and persist writes under the wrong one.
Fix pattern/constraint: leave StorageOptions.GVK empty for any resource whose storage registration isn't 1:1 with a single stable GVK. Per PR #132784's description, giving these resources GVR-keyed registration is explicitly left as a separate, not-yet-done change.
applies: apistore.StorageOptions callers for iam, app-SDK kinds installed via appinstaller, and enterprise storage registrations
